metadata.scenario: A customer calls to schedule a maintenance appointment for next week and confirms the time slot. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Rose Patterson. I'm calling to schedule a maintenance appointment for my mother next week. Hi Rose! It's great to hear from you. What day would you like to schedule the appointment? We're looking at either Tuesday or Wednesday. Let me check… Tuesday is available. What time works best for you? How about 10 AM? Does that work? Yes, 10 AM on Tuesday is perfect. Great! Just to confirm, that would be for companion care, right? Yes, that’s correct. We’ll have a familiar caregiver come by. Thank you, that really helps with her comfort. Of course, it's important for her to feel at ease. Is there anything else you need during that visit? Actually, can we also discuss adding personal care assistance for a few days next month? Absolutely! I can have a care coordinator reach out to you about that. That sounds perfect. I want to make sure we have everything in place. I’ll note that down and ensure Lisa Chen contacts you for the care plan. Thank you so much, Margaret! I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Rose! Just to recap, we have the appointment scheduled for Tuesday at 10 AM. Yes, that’s correct. And I’ll have Lisa reach out about personal care assistance. Anything else? No, that should be all for now. Thanks again! Thank you for calling, Rose. Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
